title: Find All Anagrams In A String
description: Find all start indices of p's anagrams in s using a sliding window.
pseudocode:
1. pCount = count characters in p
2. sCount = count characters in first window of s
3. for i from 0 to s.length - p.length:
4.   if sCount == pCount: add i to result
5.   update sCount by removing s[i] and adding s[i + p.length]

steps.note: Initialize sCount for first window 'cba': {c:1, b:1, a:1}
sCount matches pCount, index 0 is an anagram
Slide window: remove 'c', add 'e'. sCount: {b:1, a:1, e:1}
